Harsh Paun

Residential interior & spatial design — three rooms, full material and lighting studies, modeled and rendered in Coohom.

A real residential interior project: three rooms in a family home, modeled and rendered to the home's actual floor plan and measurements, with lighting, materials, and furnishing concepts developed independently for each space. Each room was tested in both daytime and evening light to check that the material palette — stone, wood, upholstery, brass — held together as conditions changed.

Modeled & rendered in Coohom · 2023

Primary Bedroom

View 360 panorama ↗

A suite with a fluted taupe headboard wall and mountain triptych in the sleeping area, opening onto a separate sitting area anchored by a book-matched marble and backlit wood feature wall — shown in day and evening light to test how the palette held up as conditions changed.
